column1: # One row per synced video-pipeline code file. tools/check.sh reads this for the
# video code-drift pass, same contract as manifest.tsv but a different runtime root.
# WHY A SECOND MANIFEST instead of rows in manifest.tsv: manifest.tsv's second
# column is vault-relative (Google Drive). The video pipeline deliberately lives
# OUTSIDE Drive because media files are large and Drive sync would churn on them
# (see its README). The code still belongs under version control — the repo rule
# is that durable code lives here — so the repo is the source of truth and
# ~/Movies stays the runtime, exactly the pattern manifest.tsv already uses for
# the watch-folder launchd job (retired 2026-10-18: the pipeline is MacBook-only
# NO OUTPUT BASELINES for this lane. The generator baselines in baselines/ work
# because their outputs are small text/HTML. Video outputs are large binaries and
# do not belong in git; the review mechanism for this lane is the visual pass
# logged in the pipeline's own CRITIQUE-LOG.md. Stated here so the gap is a
# recorded decision rather than an oversight.
# build-operatory-math.py is a PIECE-SPECIFIC build (the operatory-math stat video),
# kept because it carries the reusable escalator-style stat-card pattern, not because
# Premiere lane: XML import is the live path; the CEP panel is PARKED (scaffolded,
# never loaded). Tracked here rather than left to rot untracked outside git.
